```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
wd <- getwd()
data_path <- paste0(dirname(wd), '/data/BRCA_methylation_data.csv')
BRCA_methylation_data_original <- read.csv(data_path, row.names=1)
```

```{r}
wd <- getwd()
data_path <- paste0(dirname(wd), '/data/BRCA_sample_sheet.csv')
BRCA_sample_sheet <- read.csv(data_path, row.names=1)
```

```{r}
#identische Bennung der Patient-ID  Bindestrich
colnames(BRCA_methylation_data_original) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(BRCA_methylation_data_original))
```


```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(minfi)
library(IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19)
```

```{r}
#  Extract Tumor Type 
Tumor_Type <- BRCA_sample_sheet$Type
sample_ids <- BRCA_sample_sheet$TCGA.ID # Extract  Patient ID 
methylation_data_dmp <- BRCA_methylation_data_original[, sample_ids] #assign the methylation data to the extracted patient IDs
methylation_data_dmp <- as.matrix(methylation_data_dmp)
```

```{r}
# Create a phenodata object
pheno_data <- data.frame(phenotype = Tumor_Type)
rownames(pheno_data) <- sample_ids

# Run dmpFinder
dmps <- dmpFinder(methylation_data_dmp, pheno = pheno_data$phenotype, type = "categorical")

```


```{r}
# load Annotation for 450k-Chips 
ann450k <- getAnnotation(IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19)

# apply dmp 
dmps <- dmpFinder(methylation_data_dmp, pheno = pheno_data$phenotype, type = "categorical")

# Extract methylation positions from the results
meth_positions <- rownames(dmps)

# Select annotations for the methylation positions
matched_ann <- ann450k[match(meth_positions, ann450k$Name), ]

# Combining results wirh the annotation
dmps_with_ann <- cbind(dmps, matched_ann)
```

Converting the results in a CSV: 
```{r}
dmps_with_ann_df <- as.data.frame(dmps_with_ann)
write.csv(dmps_with_ann_df, "dmpFinder_Results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


# Creating Subgroups 
```{r}
methylation_data <- BRCA_methylation_data_original
methylation_data <- as.matrix(methylation_data)
```

Top 1000 CpG: 
```{r}
dmps_with_ann_subset_1000 <- head(dmps_with_ann, 1000)
Top_1000_CpG_names <- rownames(dmps_with_ann_subset_1000)
methylation_data_Top_1000 <- methylation_data[Top_1000_CpG_names, ]
methylation_data_Top_1000_df <- as.data.frame(methylation_data_Top_1000)
write.csv(methylation_data_Top_1000_df, "Top_1000_dmps.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

Top 5000 CpG: 
```{r}
dmps_with_ann_subset_5000 <- head(dmps_with_ann, 5000)
Top_5000_CpG_names <- rownames(dmps_with_ann_subset_5000)
methylation_data_Top_5000 <- methylation_data[Top_5000_CpG_names, ]
methylation_data_Top_5000_df <- as.data.frame(methylation_data_Top_5000)
write.csv(methylation_data_Top_5000_df, "Top_5000_dmps.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
